name: read.irts
title: The first tokens of the format are the time. The rest is the value matrix.

origin.description: The first tokens of the format are the time. The rest is the value matrix.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: The first tokens of the format are the time. The rest is the value matrix.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
tmp <- "/tmp/tseries-read-irts.txt"
cat("1991-01-04 17:00:00 1.5 2.5\n1991-01-05 09:30:00 3.5 4.5\n", file = tmp)
ir <- read.irts(tmp)
paste(join(as.numeric(time(ir))), join(value(ir)), sep = "|")

translation.description: The first tokens of the format are the time. The rest is the value matrix.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

translation.details: The first tokens of the format are the time. The rest is the value matrix.
translation.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
translation.example:
path = Path("/tmp/tseries-read-irts.txt")
path.write_text("1991-01-04 17:00:00 1.5 2.5\n1991-01-05 09:30:00 3.5 4.5\n")
ir = read_irts(path)
return join(ir.time) + "|" + join(np.ravel(value(ir), order="F"))
